main.description: Defines the feature types in a format namespace (e.g. org.commonmark.facet). Can be stored as an ATProto record, fetched from a URL, and validated against this schema.

wasmLens.description: WASM lens: raw:{id} ↔ {id}. source/target use the 'raw:' prefix convention.

feature.description: Behavioral descriptor for a single feature type in this namespace.

featureClass.description: Semantic class: inline span, block marker, entity (mention/link/tag), comment (e.g. HTML <!-- -->), or meta (e.g. doctype; document-level or non-structural)

expandStart.description: Peritext expand-start semantics: should this mark expand when text is inserted at its start boundary?

expandEnd.description: Peritext expand-end semantics: should this mark expand when text is inserted at its end boundary?

void.description: If true, this feature cannot have child content (e.g. HTML void elements like hr, img, br). Used by import/export to avoid attributing following content to this block or inline.

specSection.description: Section reference in the authoritative spec (for documentation)
